stories.title: Anthropic releases new Mythos and Fable models amid RSI concerns
stories.take: Anthropic says the new models improve coding, reasoning and vision — and land in the middle of the recursive self-improvement debate.

stories.title: Fervo now has $12B in orders for its geothermal power tech
stories.take: $12B in orders at its 8.4 GW Utah resource — geothermal is now pitching itself as a direct rival to natural gas.

stories.title: Jensen Huang pulls out of ElevenLabs Summit amid Nvidia controversy
stories.take: Huang also skipped an Anthropic event — the alleged-spy affair story is now costing Nvidia its CEO's public schedule.

stories.title: Vulnerability that lets hackers SSH into Linux devices is under active exploitation
stories.take: The '*sshole' flaw is being exploited in the wild — patch Linux devices that accept SSH connections.

stories.title: Meta releases Muse Ember, a new lightweight model for agent execution
stories.take: At 10 cents per million input tokens, Ember undercuts Haiku-class rivals for cheap agent work.

stories.title: Claude Code is accidentally exposing secrets all over GitHub
stories.take: A 'do not ask again' prompt path has led users to share passwords and API keys publicly — check your repos.

stories.title: The backlash about data centers might really just be about electricity
stories.take: MIT Tech Review's read: voter anger at data centers tracks power bills more than AI itself.

stories.title: Why publishers must act now to protect content from AI scrapers
stories.take: Digiday's argument: each tech wave promised publishers reach, then took the leverage — scraping defenses are the fight this time.

stories.title: Disney's AI deal with Adobe is raising eyebrows
stories.take: Creative Bloq asks whether Disney's Adobe AI deal is a problem or actually the cleanest rights solution either company has.

stories.title: OpenAI's Monetization Chief to Ad Partners: User Trust Means Some Things 'We Just Can't' Do
stories.take: OpenAI tells ad partners privacy rules will block some requests — and won't own the reported $100 billion ad target.

stories.title: Ogilvy and CAA launch partnership to clone celebrity talent for AI ads
stories.take: Terry Crews and other big names could appear in AI-generated ads — licensed, and marked as AI.

stories.title: The AI-or-Not Debate Is Advertising's Most Pointless Argument
stories.take: Adweek's take: almost nothing you watch or read is AI-free anymore, so the binary debate is already over.

stories.title: Miami Heat to host 2028 NBA All-Star Weekend, first time since 1990, per report
stories.take: Miami gets All-Star Weekend for only the second time in franchise history.

stories.title: Reaves steps into Luka's shoes, drops 43 in win vs. Pistons
stories.take: With Luka resting, Austin Reaves scored 43 in the 121–116 win — the Lakers' depth keeps producing headline nights.

stories.title: Giannis on Doc criticism: I won't be thwarted by 'bitterness or pettiness'
stories.take: Giannis says he was 'speechless' at Doc Rivers calling out his basketball IQ — the feud is now public.

stories.title: NBA's biggest winners and losers of the week: Luka's Lakers look amazing, are Hornets regretting LaMelo trade?
stories.take: CBS's weekly ledger: Lakers up, and Charlotte already second-guessing the LaMelo deal.

stories.title: Nuggets' starters all questionable vs. Rockets after delays leaving Mexico
stories.take: Plane delays out of Mexico City leave Denver's entire starting five questionable for Monday in Houston.

stories.title: MLB rumors: Why the Cubs may already be out on Tarik Skubal, plus latest on Phillies, Cardinals, more
stories.take: GM meetings could heat up the hot stove — but Chicago may already be priced out of the Skubal sweepstakes.

stories.title: Your guide to MLB free agency: Rankings and contract projections for the top 50 free agents
stories.take: Kiley McDaniel prices the top 50 free agents — the winter's spending map in one list.

stories.title: Pedro Martinez appeals to MLB, players: 'Get something done' to avoid lockout
stories.take: Pedro's plea to both sides: settle the CBA and don't lock out the fans.

stories.title: MLB Awards Week: Predictions and everything you need to know about MVP, Cy Young and more
stories.take: Awards Week starts tonight with the Rookies of the Year — MVP and Cy Young follow.

stories.title: Thomas Massie files articles of impeachment against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth
stories.take: A Republican congressman accuses Hegseth of waging war on Iran in violation of the War Powers Resolution — a forced vote looms.

stories.title: Russell Brand is sentenced to more than 10 years in prison for rape and sexual assault
stories.take: Brand was found guilty of attacking four of six accusers, in cases dating back to 2004.

stories.title: Senate votes on bill to speed up projects from gas pipelines to clean energy
stories.take: The permitting bill would speed everything from pipelines to clean energy — and environmentalists are split on the trade.

stories.title: Boosting healthcare and ending the Iran war are top of the to-do list for House Democrats once they have majority
stories.take: Incoming House Democrats put healthcare and ending the Iran war first — the post-midterm agenda is taking shape.

stories.title: Trump admits deportation policy was 'too tough' despite promotion of Stephen Miller
stories.take: A rare admission from Trump that a signature policy became a political liability — even as Miller starts as chief of staff.

stories.title: Boeing to cut about 5% of its commercial plane workforce
stories.take: Layoffs and attrition as Boeing slows its production ramp — about 5% of the commercial workforce goes.

stories.title: Gavin Newsom busca vaciar el corredor de la muerte y conmuta las sentencias de cientos de presos
stories.take: Newsom commuted the death sentences of 548 state prisoners, saying state-sanctioned killing conflicts with California's values — victims' families are furious.

stories.title: High surf and strong rip current in SoCal raise risk of flooding and hazardous swim conditions
stories.take: High surf and rip currents raise flood and swim risks through midweek — rain and high tides return this weekend.

stories.title: Beating of Danish tourist near Venice Boardwalk captured on video, one suspect arrested
stories.take: One suspect in the Venice Boardwalk beating has turned himself in; police are still searching for the second attacker.

stories.title: Naples Boat Parade canceled as El Niño season threatens dangerously high tides over Christmas week
stories.take: Long Beach's Naples Island parade is off — expected Christmas-week tides and surf made it unsafe.

stories.title: After Silicon Valley spending spree, more moderate Democrats are heading to the Capitol
stories.take: Tech-backed super PACs spent tens of millions boosting centrist Democrats — and almost all of their picks won.

stories.title: More than a dozen runners fall ill at Santa Barbara half-marathon
stories.take: At least 19 runners were hospitalized Sunday; organizers blame heat exhaustion, medics aren't fully convinced.

stories.title: Nvidia CEO Admits Affair With Suspected Chinese Spy
stories.take: Huang admitted the affair in a company-wide email Sunday night; the other party is Alice Huang of Megaspeed, the Singapore cloud firm that gave Chinese labs remote access to export-controlled Nvidia GPUs • A memo circulated at the White House last spring identified Alice as a suspected Chinese Ministry of State Security spy; Nvidia's board has opened an independent investigation and says it has no reason to believe secrets were compromised • Trump is standing by Huang and China calls the spy claims groundless slander

stories.title: Jensen and The Honeypot
stories.take: Kantrowitz frames it as a classic honeypot: a secret affair made the CEO of America's most important AI company compromisable — 'not a marriage issue… a corporate security issue, a national security issue' • Key-man risk is extreme: about 60 direct reports, no successor, and his credibility arguing against China export controls is likely gone • His bet: Huang survives and stays CEO — 'NVIDIA needs him. He needs NVIDIA' — while Dario Amodei and Google gain

stories.title: "Impeach Hegseth"
stories.take: WaPo's Dan Lamothe: the eight-month Iran war and war-driven gas prices were a major reason Republicans lost the midterms; a Massie-led vote to impeach Hegseth is likely this week and may pass the House • Grounds taking shape: waging war past its legal duration without authorization, the Caribbean boat strikes, and the firing of generals • Second half: Trump wants to phase out the ~$4B-a-year aid package to Israel — Haaretz's Ben Samuels says that's Netanyahu's own plan to shift support into Pentagon contracts; December 11 is the date to watch

stories.title: Nvidia Probe Into CEO Affair Raises Thorny Questions for AI
stories.take: Analyst view: ousting Huang is 'almost unthinkable' absent something egregious — no succession plan, a 3.4% stake and 60 direct reports; watch Nvidia earnings November 17 and the November 18 congressional hearing • Founder-fund manager Monahan backs Jensen for now, but if he goes, 'our process is to sell the stock' • Also covered: Berkshire's ~$357B cash pile and $9.6B of buybacks, and CVS's pharmacy spinoff, which S&P put on review for a possible two-notch upgrade
